items.content_text: - **CFTC splits prediction markets from sportsbook in paired rulemaking after circuit court split, Mavengity reports** — The CFTC interim final rule follows the Third Circuit approach in KalshiEX v. Flaherty, after the Sixth Circuit in September and the Ninth Circuit in August treated sports event contracts as indistinguishable from sports wagers.
